data.name: textBoxDescription.Text
data.value:
Thank you for using Industrial Park! This tool was made by igorseabra4, Pepperpot, EnergyDrink, and friends and contributors from the Heavy Iron Modding community, using .NET and SharpDX.
It is a HIP/HOP archive viewer and editor for the following games: - Scooby-Doo: Night of 100 Frights - SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle For Bikini Bottom - The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie - The Incredibles - The Incredibles: Rise of the Underminer - Ratatouille (Jan 18th, 2006 Prototype) by Heavy Iron Studios for GameCube, Xbox, PlayStation 2, PC.
Additional credits go to: - actualchatterteeth - Dark - Joey - MinecraftFreak73 - Seil - Suprnova - TetraxZ and other members of the games' online communities for contributions on code and discoveries, including AR/Gecko codes used by the Randomizer.
External tools used: - TxdGen - vgmstream Flag icons courtesy of Flagpedia.net
For documentation and user guide, please consult the Heavy Iron Modding wiki, linked below. For questions, suggestions, problems or any other reasons, you can reach me and the rest of the community on Discord: please join the Heavy Iron Modding server, linked below. For the source code, the GitHub repository is linked below. ~igorseabra4
